14:47.text: So think not that Allâh will fail to keep His Promise to His Messengers. Certainly, Allâh is All-Mighty, All-Able of Retribution.

14:48.text: On the Day when the earth will be changed to another earth and so will be the heavens, and they
will appear before Allâh, the One, the Irresistible.

14:49.text: And you will see the Mujrimûn
(criminals, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allâh - Islâmic Monotheism, polytheists)

14:50.text: Their garments will be of pitch, and fire will cover their faces.

14:51.text: That Allâh may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allâh is Swift at reckoning.
